title: Threats against Asberg and his family over the Baltic Sea anomaly

tellings.quote: Uh not really, but you know, you get mails and and like threatening me and my kids and and uh lots of things like that.

plain: After his team found a strange shape on the floor of the Baltic Sea, which some call a UFO on the seafloor, Dennis Asberg says he received messages threatening him and his children. Asberg, a Swedish treasure hunter who led the find, tells this himself about the years since 2011, mentioning "lots of things like that".
